```{=html}
<style>
html,
body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
}

#quarto-header,
#title-block-header,
.quarto-title-block,
.page-navigation,
footer.footer {
    display: none !important;
}

main.content,
main.content > section {
    max-width: none !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
}

.inflation-root {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1015px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 10px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.inflation-root * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.desktop-controls {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.view-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
    border: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #f7f7f7;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.view-toggle button {
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    padding: 9px 14px;
    font-size: 12.25px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #333;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.view-toggle button.is-selected {
    background: white;
}

.desktop-layout {
    display: flex;
    gap: 13px;
    align-items: stretch;
    margin-bottom: 13px;
}

.desktop-layout.distribution-only .desktop-table-card {
    display: none;
}

.desktop-layout.distribution-only .desktop-plot-card {
    flex: 1 1 100%;
}

.desktop-layout.split-view .desktop-plot-card {
    flex: 1.65;
}

.desktop-layout.split-view .desktop-table-card {
    flex: 1;
    display: block;
}

.desktop-card,
.mobile-card {
    background-color: white;
    border: 0.5px solid #ddd;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.desktop-card-header {
    padding: 9px 11px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
    background: #f7f7f7;
    font-size: 12.25px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #333;
}

.desktop-card-body {
    padding: 9px;
}

.desktop-plot-container {
    width: 100%;
    height: 338px;
}

.desktop-table-container {
    width: 100%;
}

.mobile-card {
    display: none;
    width: 100%;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.viz-tabs {
    display: flex;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
    background: #f7f7f7;
}

.viz-tab {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 9px 10px;
    font-size: 11.25px;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #333;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.viz-tab.is-selected {
    background: white;
}

.viz-panel {
    display: none;
    padding: 8px;
}

.viz-panel.is-selected {
    display: block;
}

.mobile-plot-container {
    width: 100%;
    height: 207px;
}

.mobile-table-container {
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: visible;
}

.switch-hint {
    margin-top: 6px;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #555;
    line-height: 1.25;
}

.switch-link {
    border: none;
    background: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin-left: 4px;
    color: #0a66c2;
    text-decoration: underline;
    cursor: pointer;
    font: inherit;
}

.controls-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 4px;
    gap: 0;
}

.slider-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 720px;
    margin-bottom: 13px;
    padding: 0 2px;
}

.slider-container label {
    width: 100%;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: normal;
    color: #333;
    line-height: 1.28;
    text-align: center;
}

.slider-container input[type="range"] {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 560px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: block;
}

.slider-container span.value-display {
    margin-top: 5px;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 15px;
}

.slider-labels-bottom {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 560px;
    margin-top: 5px;
}

.slider-labels-bottom span {
    font-size: 11.25px;
}

table {
    border-collapse: collapse;
    width: 100%;
    font-size: 11.25px;
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    background: white;
}

th,
td {
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    padding: 7.5px 6.5px;
    text-align: center;
}

th {
    background-color: #f2f2f2;
    color: #333;
    font-weight: bold;
}

tr:nth-child(even) {
    background-color: #f9f9f9;
}

#varianceValue {
    display: none;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    html,
    body {
        overflow: auto;
    }

    .inflation-root {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 8px;
    }

    .desktop-controls,
    .desktop-layout {
        display: none;
    }

    .mobile-card {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .controls-container {
        margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .slider-container {
        max-width: 100%;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        padding: 0;
    }

    .slider-container label {
        font-size: 12.25px;
        line-height: 1.2;
        margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .slider-container input[type="range"],
    .slider-labels-bottom {
        width: 88%;
        max-width: 420px;
    }

    .slider-container span.value-display {
        margin-top: 4px;
        font-size: 14px;
    }

    .slider-labels-bottom {
        margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .slider-labels-bottom span,
    th,
    td {
        font-size: 11px;
    }

    th,
    td {
        padding: 7px 5px;
    }
}
</style>

<div class="inflation-root">
    <div class="desktop-controls" id="desktopControls">
        <div class="view-toggle" aria-label="Visualization view">
            <button type="button" class="is-selected" id="splitViewBtn">Distribution + table</button>
            <button type="button" id="distributionOnlyBtn">Distribution only</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="desktop-layout split-view" id="desktopLayout">
        <div class="desktop-card desktop-plot-card">
            <div class="desktop-card-header">Distribution</div>
            <div class="desktop-card-body">
                <div id="desktopPlot" class="desktop-plot-container"></div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="desktop-card desktop-table-card">
            <div class="desktop-card-header">Interval probabilities</div>
            <div class="desktop-card-body">
                <div class="desktop-table-container">
                    <table id="desktopIntervalTable">
                        <thead>
                            <tr>
                                <th>Inflation interval</th>
                                <th>Chance (%)</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody id="desktopIntervalTableBody"></tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="mobile-card" id="mobileCard">
        <div class="viz-tabs">
            <button type="button" class="viz-tab is-selected" id="graphTab">Graph</button>
            <button type="button" class="viz-tab" id="tableTab">Table</button>
        </div>

        <div class="viz-panel is-selected" id="graphPanel">
            <div id="mobilePlot" class="mobile-plot-container"></div>
            <div class="switch-hint">
                Need exact interval probabilities?
                <button type="button" class="switch-link" id="toTableLink">Go to table</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="viz-panel" id="tablePanel">
            <div id="mobileTableContainer" class="mobile-table-container">
                <table id="mobileIntervalTable">
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th>Inflation interval</th>
                            <th>Chance (%)</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody id="mobileIntervalTableBody"></tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
            <div class="switch-hint">
                Prefer the visual distribution?
                <button type="button" class="switch-link" id="toGraphLink">Go to graph</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="controls-container">
        <div class="slider-container">
            <label for="mean">What do you expect the rate of inflation to be over the next twelve months?</label>
            <input type="range" step="0.01" id="mean">
            <span id="meanValue" class="value-display"></span>
        </div>

        <div class="slider-container">
            <label for="variance">How uncertain are you about the rate you have just chosen?</label>
            <input type="range" min="0.001" max="1" step="0.001" id="variance" value="0.001">
            <div class="slider-labels-bottom">
                <span>More certain</span>
                <span>More uncertain</span>
            </div>
            <span id="varianceValue">0.001</span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jstat/1.9.4/jstat.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-latest.min.js"></script>
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var min = -5.00;
    var max = 15.00;
    var av = (min + max) / 2;
    var minCC = min + 0.0000000001;
    var maxCC = max - 0.0000000001;

    var adjustedMin = min + 0.02 * (max - min);
    var adjustedMax = max - 0.02 * (max - min);

    var buffer = 0.01 * (max - min);
    var plotMin = min - buffer;
    var plotMax = max + buffer;

    var meanSlider = document.getElementById('mean');
    var varianceSlider = document.getElementById('variance');
    var meanValue = document.getElementById('meanValue');
    var varianceValue = document.getElementById('varianceValue');

    var desktopPlotDiv = document.getElementById('desktopPlot');
    var mobilePlotDiv = document.getElementById('mobilePlot');

    var desktopIntervalTableBody = document.getElementById('desktopIntervalTableBody');
    var mobileIntervalTableBody = document.getElementById('mobileIntervalTableBody');

    var graphTab = document.getElementById('graphTab');
    var tableTab = document.getElementById('tableTab');
    var graphPanel = document.getElementById('graphPanel');
    var tablePanel = document.getElementById('tablePanel');
    var toTableLink = document.getElementById('toTableLink');
    var toGraphLink = document.getElementById('toGraphLink');

    var desktopLayout = document.getElementById('desktopLayout');
    var splitViewBtn = document.getElementById('splitViewBtn');
    var distributionOnlyBtn = document.getElementById('distributionOnlyBtn');

    meanSlider.setAttribute('min', adjustedMin);
    meanSlider.setAttribute('max', adjustedMax);
    meanSlider.setAttribute('value', av);
    meanValue.innerHTML = formatNumber(av, 2) + ' %';

    function isMobileView() {
        return window.innerWidth <= 768;
    }

    function getIntervals() {
        return [
            [max - 2 * (max - min) / 16, maxCC],
            [max - 4 * (max - min) / 16, max - 2 * (max - min) / 16],
            [max - 6 * (max - min) / 16, max - 4 * (max - min) / 16],
            [max - 7 * (max - min) / 16, max - 6 * (max - min) / 16],
            [max - 8 * (max - min) / 16, max - 7 * (max - min) / 16],
            [max - 9 * (max - min) / 16, max - 8 * (max - min) / 16],
            [max - 10 * (max - min) / 16, max - 9 * (max - min) / 16],
            [max - 12 * (max - min) / 16, max - 10 * (max - min) / 16],
            [max - 14 * (max - min) / 16, max - 12 * (max - min) / 16],
            [minCC, max - 14 * (max - min) / 16]
        ];
    }

    function setDesktopView(mode) {
        if (mode === 'distributionOnly') {
            desktopLayout.classList.remove('split-view');
            desktopLayout.classList.add('distribution-only');
            splitViewBtn.classList.remove('is-selected');
            distributionOnlyBtn.classList.add('is-selected');
        } else {
            desktopLayout.classList.remove('distribution-only');
            desktopLayout.classList.add('split-view');
            distributionOnlyBtn.classList.remove('is-selected');
            splitViewBtn.classList.add('is-selected');
        }

        setTimeout(function() {
            if (window.Plotly && !isMobileView()) {
                Plotly.Plots.resize(desktopPlotDiv);
            }
        }, 60);
    }

    function switchMobileTab(tabName) {
        if (tabName === 'graph') {
            graphTab.classList.add('is-selected');
            tableTab.classList.remove('is-selected');
            graphPanel.classList.add('is-selected');
            tablePanel.classList.remove('is-selected');

            setTimeout(function() {
                if (window.Plotly && isMobileView()) {
                    Plotly.Plots.resize(mobilePlotDiv);
                }
            }, 50);
        } else {
            tableTab.classList.add('is-selected');
            graphTab.classList.remove('is-selected');
            tablePanel.classList.add('is-selected');
            graphPanel.classList.remove('is-selected');
        }
    }

    function formatNumber(value, decimals) {
        return Number(value).toFixed(decimals);
    }

    function formatPercent(value, decimals) {
        return formatNumber(value, decimals) + '%';
    }

    function buildXAxisTicks() {
        var span = max - min;
        var step = span <= 8 ? 1 : 5;
        var ticks = [];
        var start = Math.ceil(min / step) * step;
        for (var tick = start; tick <= max + 0.000001; tick += step) {
            ticks.push(parseFloat(tick.toFixed(6)));
        }
        if (ticks.length === 0 || ticks[0] > min) ticks.unshift(min);
        if (ticks[ticks.length - 1] < max) ticks.push(max);
        return ticks;
    }

    function formatAxisTick(value) {
        return Math.abs(value - Math.round(value)) < 0.000001 ? formatNumber(value, 0) : formatNumber(value, 1);
    }

    function calculateMaxVariance(mean) {
        var maxVariance;
        if (mean > min && mean < max) {
            if (mean > min && max > -min + 2 * mean) {
                maxVariance = ((max * Math.pow(min, 2) - 2 * max * min * mean - Math.pow(min, 2) * mean + max * Math.pow(mean, 2) + 2 * min * Math.pow(mean, 2) - Math.pow(mean, 3)) / (max - 2 * min + mean));
            } else if ((mean > min && max === -min + 2 * mean) || (mean > min && mean < max && max < -min + 2 * mean)) {
                maxVariance = ((-Math.pow(max, 2) * min + Math.pow(max, 2) * mean + 2 * max * min * mean - 2 * max * Math.pow(mean, 2) - min * Math.pow(mean, 2) + Math.pow(mean, 3)) / (2 * max - min - mean));
            }
        } else {
            maxVariance = 0;
        }
        return maxVariance * 0.98;
    }

    function updateTable(tableBody, alpha, beta, x, y) {
        tableBody.innerHTML = '';

        var intervals = getIntervals();
        var totalPercentage = 0;
        var percentages = [];
        var rows = [];
        var maxPercentage = 0;
        var maxIndex = -1;

        intervals.forEach(function(interval, index) {
            var lower = interval[0];
            var upper = interval[1];
            var percentage = integratePDF(lower, upper, alpha, beta, x, y);
            percentages.push(percentage);

            if (percentage > maxPercentage) {
                maxPercentage = percentage;
                maxIndex = index;
            }

            var displayLower = index === intervals.length - 1 ? min : lower;
            var displayUpper = index === 0 ? max : upper;

            var row = '<tr>' +
                '<td>' + formatPercent(displayLower, 2) + ' to ' + formatPercent(displayUpper, 2) + '</td>' +
                '<td>' + formatNumber(percentage, 2) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>';
            rows.push(row);
            totalPercentage += percentage;
        });

        if (totalPercentage.toFixed(2) !== '100.00' && maxIndex >= 0) {
            var difference = 100 - totalPercentage;
            percentages[maxIndex] += difference;

            var correctedLower = maxIndex === intervals.length - 1 ? min : intervals[maxIndex][0];
            var correctedUpper = maxIndex === 0 ? max : intervals[maxIndex][1];

            rows[maxIndex] = '<tr>' +
                '<td>' + formatPercent(correctedLower, 2) + ' to ' + formatPercent(correctedUpper, 2) + '</td>' +
                '<td>' + formatNumber(percentages[maxIndex], 2) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>';
        }

        rows.forEach(function(row) {
            tableBody.innerHTML += row;
        });
    }

    function integratePDF(lower, upper, alpha, beta, x, y) {
        var total = 0;
        var dx = 0.01;
        for (var i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
            if (x[i] >= lower && x[i] <= upper) {
                total += y[i] * dx;
            }
        }
        return total * 100;
    }

    function plotInto(targetDiv, x, y) {
        var isMobile = targetDiv === mobilePlotDiv;
        var ticks = buildXAxisTicks();

        var layout = {
            autosize: true,
            yaxis: { showgrid: false, showticklabels: false },
            xaxis: {
                title: {
                    text: 'Inflation (in percent)',
                    font: { size: isMobile ? 10 : 11 }
                },
                tickfont: { size: isMobile ? 11 : 12 },
                showticklabels: true,
                tickvals: ticks,
                ticktext: ticks.map(formatAxisTick),
                showgrid: true,
                fixedrange: true
            },
            showlegend: false,
            hovermode: false,
            margin: isMobile
                ? { t: 4, l: 12, r: 12, b: 34 }
                : { t: 6, l: 16, r: 16, b: 40 }
        };

        var config = {
            displayModeBar: false,
            staticPlot: true,
            responsive: true
        };

        Plotly.newPlot(targetDiv, [{
            x: x,
            y: y,
            type: 'scatter',
            mode: 'lines'
        }], layout, config);
    }

    function updatePlot() {
        var mean = parseFloat(meanSlider.value);
        var varianceSliderValue = parseFloat(varianceSlider.value);
        var maxVariance = calculateMaxVariance(mean);
        var variance = Math.pow(varianceSliderValue, 2) * maxVariance;

        if (isNaN(variance) || variance < 0) variance = 0;

        var alpha = ((min - mean) * (min * max - min * mean - max * mean + Math.pow(mean, 2) + variance)) / (variance * (max - min));
        var beta = -((max - mean) * (min * max - min * mean - max * mean + Math.pow(mean, 2) + variance)) / (variance * (max - min));

        var x = [];
        var y = [];
        var dx = 0.01;

        for (var i = plotMin; i <= plotMax; i += dx) {
            x.push(i);
            y.push(jStat.beta.pdf((i - min) / (max - min), alpha, beta) / (max - min));
        }

        plotInto(desktopPlotDiv, x, y);
        plotInto(mobilePlotDiv, x, y);

        meanValue.innerHTML = formatNumber(mean, 2) + ' %';
        varianceValue.innerHTML = formatNumber(variance, 4);

        updateTable(desktopIntervalTableBody, alpha, beta, x, y);
        updateTable(mobileIntervalTableBody, alpha, beta, x, y);
    }

    graphTab.addEventListener('click', function() {
        switchMobileTab('graph');
    });

    tableTab.addEventListener('click', function() {
        switchMobileTab('table');
    });

    toTableLink.addEventListener('click', function() {
        switchMobileTab('table');
    });

    toGraphLink.addEventListener('click', function() {
        switchMobileTab('graph');
    });

    splitViewBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        setDesktopView('split');
    });

    distributionOnlyBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        setDesktopView('distributionOnly');
    });

    meanSlider.addEventListener('input', updatePlot);
    varianceSlider.addEventListener('input', updatePlot);

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
        if (window.Plotly) {
            if (isMobileView()) {
                Plotly.Plots.resize(mobilePlotDiv);
            } else {
                Plotly.Plots.resize(desktopPlotDiv);
            }
        }
    });

    updatePlot();
    setDesktopView('split');
    switchMobileTab('graph');
});
</script>
```
